fingerprint.structure: 8 slides: hook → what is it → know the difference (vs. a look-alike) → why it works (3-step icon flow) → safe % chart → honest timeline → pair with / avoid → disclaimer + follow CTA
fingerprint.hook: Ingredient-spotlight hook: pill label 'INGREDIENT SPOTLIGHT' + huge ingredient name + 'check your skincare! 👀' + curiosity question 'what is it, really?'
fingerprint.pacing: Low text density: 5–15 words per slide, one idea per slide
fingerprint.text_overlay: Bold rounded sans (closest: Inter / SF Pro Bold), all lowercase except pill labels; small uppercase letter-spaced pill label above each title; titles in a deep shade of the slide's pastel; centered; short body lines in the same hue; no outlines or boxes.
fingerprint.audio: Trending OPM song (Kung Ako Na Lang Sana – Sarah Geronimo), not original
fingerprint.arc: Curiosity → clarity → practical rules → reassurance; payoff = the safe % and timeline (save-worthy reference)
